source_meta._title: Creepers can't blow up the boat and boat with chest they ride, when it is on the land

stor.environment: Vanilla Minecraft Java Edition snapshot 16w03a in a local single-player Creative-mode world. Use a default Superflat world to provide unobstructed dry land, and use a non-Peaceful difficulty so the Creeper remains present.
preconditions: Install or select the historical Java Edition snapshot profile for Minecraft 16w03a; do not use the fix version 23w33a.
Use an unmodded client so entity, boat, collision, and explosion behavior are not altered.
Use a local single-player world; the report does not require a dedicated server or multiple players.
Use Creative mode to obtain the required entities and items and to prevent the Creeper from naturally targeting the player while it is being pushed into position.
Set difficulty to Normal or another non-Peaceful difficulty; a Creeper spawned on Peaceful difficulty will not remain available for the test.
Prepare an ordinary wooden boat, one Creeper spawn egg, and flint and steel in separate hotbar slots.
The test boat must be placed entirely on solid dry land, not in water.
Use the plain-boat reproduction in 16w03a. Boat-with-chest and bamboo-raft variants do not exist in this recommended historical version.

steps.action: In the Minecraft Launcher, create or select an installation that runs the exact Java Edition snapshot listed as the recommended affected version, then start the game with that installation.
steps.success_cue: The Minecraft main menu is open and its displayed version is 16w03a.

steps.action: Open the single-player world list and begin creating a new world.
steps.success_cue: The Create New World screen is open.

steps.action: Change the new world's game mode to Creative. Open More World Options, cycle World Type until Superflat is selected, retain the default Superflat preset, and return to the main world-creation screen.
steps.exact_input: Game Mode: Creative; More World Options... -> World Type: Superflat -> Done
steps.success_cue: The creation screen shows Creative mode and the default Superflat world type.

steps.action: Create the world and wait until terrain rendering finishes and movement responds normally.
steps.success_cue: The player is standing in a loaded, flat grassy world and can move without chunk-loading pauses.

steps.action: Confirm that the difficulty is not Peaceful. If necessary, open the pause menu and Options screen and cycle the Difficulty button until it displays Normal, then return to the world.
steps.exact_input: Esc -> Options... -> Difficulty: Normal -> Done -> Back to Game
steps.success_cue: The world is active on Normal difficulty and hostile entities will not be removed because of Peaceful difficulty.

steps.action: Open the Creative inventory. The hotbar is the row of nine item slots along the bottom of the screen.
steps.success_cue: The Creative inventory interface and the nine hotbar slots are visible.

steps.action: Use the Creative inventory search tab to locate an ordinary wooden Boat, a Creeper spawn egg, and Flint and Steel. Search for "boat", "creeper", and "flint" as needed. For the Creeper item, select the spawn egg whose tooltip identifies a Creeper even if the historical display name is formatted as "Spawn Creeper". Place the three items into separate hotbar slots. Do not select any raft or chest-boat item if testing a later affected version.
steps.success_cue: An ordinary Boat, the Creeper spawn egg, and Flint and Steel occupy three distinct hotbar slots.

steps.action: Close the inventory and select the hotbar slot containing the Boat, using its corresponding number key or the mouse wheel.
steps.exact_input: E, then the Boat slot's number key
steps.success_cue: The Boat item is visible in the player's active hand.

steps.action: Move to an open patch with at least five clear blocks around the intended test point. Aim at the top face of a grass block and use the Boat item once to place the boat directly on the grass. Ensure no part of the boat is touching water.
steps.success_cue: An empty ordinary boat is resting entirely on solid dry land with open space around it.

steps.action: Select the Creeper spawn egg. Aim at the ground approximately two blocks from one side of the boat and use the egg exactly once to create one Creeper. Avoid clicking directly on the boat.
steps.exact_input: Select the Creeper spawn egg slot, then right-click the grass once
steps.success_cue: Exactly one Creeper is standing close to the land-based boat.

steps.action: Select an empty hotbar slot so that an accidental use action cannot create another Creeper or ignite anything. Position the player behind the Creeper so the Creeper is approximately between the player and the empty boat.
steps.exact_input: Select an empty hotbar slot; use W/A/S/D to align
steps.success_cue: The player, Creeper, and boat are aligned, with the Creeper facing or standing toward the boat and the player behind it.

steps.action: Walk forward into the Creeper to push it toward and onto the boat. Continue applying gentle forward movement until the Creeper snaps into the boat's passenger position. Stop moving once it is seated; do not enter the boat yourself.
steps.exact_input: Hold W while colliding with the Creeper, then release W when it becomes a passenger
steps.success_cue: The Creeper is visibly seated inside the boat, the player is outside it, and the occupied boat is still entirely on dry land.

steps.action: Select the hotbar slot containing Flint and Steel. Remain close enough to reach the seated Creeper without entering the boat.
steps.exact_input: Press the Flint and Steel slot's number key
steps.success_cue: Flint and Steel is visible in the active hand while the Creeper remains seated in the land-based boat.

steps.action: Aim the crosshair at the seated Creeper's upper body rather than at the boat or ground, then use Flint and Steel on the Creeper exactly once to start its fuse. Do not strike the Creeper, move the boat, enter the boat, or interact again. If the click places a fire block or mounts the player instead of starting the fuse, reset the boat-and-Creeper setup and repeat this step rather than continuing.
steps.success_cue: The Creeper begins flashing and hissing while it is still seated in the boat on dry land; the observation subsystem must take control before detonation.

stor.handoff_condition: The Creeper's fuse has just been started with Flint and Steel while the Creeper remains the passenger of an ordinary boat resting entirely on dry land. Begin observing the occupied boat through the imminent detonation without performing any further player interaction.
uncertainties: The report does not specify game mode, world type, difficulty, seed, or coordinates. Creative mode, Normal difficulty, and a default Superflat world are practical choices that make the stated push-and-explode procedure deterministic without changing the required boat-on-land condition.

The report does not specify how to make the Creeper explode. Using Flint and Steel directly on the Creeper was externally verified as an available deterministic ignition method and avoids relying on hostile targeting while positioning the Creeper.

The first affected version, Minecraft 16w03a, predates boats with chests, so this plan exercises the ordinary-boat path supported by that version. A boat-with-chest variant would require a separately selected affected version from 1.19 or later and must not replace 16w03a as recommended_version.

The report also lists horse and llama reproduction variants, but the plan uses the simplest primary reproduction associated with the issue title: a Creeper riding an ordinary boat on land. The report separately notes that the horse and llama cases were fixed in 20w18a.
The amount and direction of manual pushing are not specified by the report. The executor should stop as soon as the Creeper visibly becomes a boat passenger.
